corrected_fields.summary: NRG Energy, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 14, 2026 disclosing concurrent offerings of senior secured notes due 2031 ($500M at 4.955%) and senior unsecured notes ($1.05B 5.875% due 2034; $1.05B 6.125% due 2036). A subsidiary, Lightning Power, LLC, also commenced a tender offer for any and all of its $1.5B outstanding 7.250% senior secured notes due 2032, along with a consent solicitation to eliminate restrictive covenants and release collateral.
